title: An event time with optional parts

blocks.text: An events feed gives each event's local time as text, but not always in full: sometimes with seconds, sometimes without, and for all-day events as a date alone.

items: `2024-03-15` has **no time at all**: it means the start of that day, `00:00`.

blocks.text: **Any other text throws** `DateTimeParseException`: a fraction of a second, seconds without a time, or a date or time that does not exist.

cases.says: A date, a T and a time with seconds is read as that LocalDateTime.
A fraction of a second, seconds without a time, February 30 and 24:00 are all refused.

concepts: Square brackets in a pattern mark an optional section, so one formatter can read a date with or without its time.
A date-only string cannot be parsed straight into a LocalDateTime; the missing time must be supplied.
